verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with case-preparation software, so a sandbox or test environment for programmatic or agentic use is a fair axis that it could plausibly offer. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or developer environment. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, and the platform is described only as a tool for uploading documents and tracking case readiness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
